title: Replacement of Mains UG cable from EB meter to Powerhouse at Alleppey Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for replacing the mains underground cable from the electricity board meter to the power house at Alleppey (Alappuzha) Lighthouse, Kerala, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Alleppey Lighthouse
sites.work: Replacement of mains UG cable from EB meter to power house

scope.item: Replacement of Mains UG cable from EB meter to Powerhouse

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; original to reach one day before last day of bid submission (26.09.2025 15:00). Small scale industries with valid NSIC/MSME certificate for related stores/service exempt from EMD.

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or their authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: Scanned Section-1 short NIT only; no BOQ, cable specification, completion period or eligibility details. Download and bid submission period 17.09.2025 09:00 to 29.09.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 30.09.2025 10:00.
